note: point_of_sale: report_sale_details.get_sale_details cleared the 20-unit budget, 41 -> under it, by being split along what it does rather than left as one 380-line method: _get_report_currency, _accumulate_products_and_taxes, _serialize_products_by_category, _get_report_scope, _count_cash_payment, _count_non_cash_payment, _prepare_uncounted_cash_row and _prepare_counting_difference_moves. Three of those existed only as duplication -- the sold and refunded product maps were serialised by the same thirty lines twice, and the profit/loss cash_moves entry had four copies differing only in how each had already decided profit from loss. No behaviour change: verified against a golden dump of three get_sale_details payloads taken before the split and compared field by field after each extraction. The two remaining offenders in point_of_sale are pos_session._accumulate_amounts (26) and stock_picking._add_mls_related_to_order (21).
